All services

Everything I do, in one list

Forty-five services across four areas. Same person on all of them, which is the point: the site, the search work, and your Google profile get built to fit each other.

Website designer

I build custom websites for small businesses in Denton and DFW. Fast, mobile-friendly, and structured so customers and Google both understand what you do.

  • website design

    A full professional custom website built around your business, not a template. Fast, mobile-friendly, and structured so both customers and Google understand what you do and where. Every project starts with a working demo you can see before committing to anything.

  • Website Maintenance

    Ongoing upkeep to keep your site running the way it did on launch day. Covers analytics, speed, content updates, hosting, and catching issues before they cost you visitors. Pairs with SEO and GBP work so the site keeps performing without added effort on your end.

  • Website redesign

    Turn a dated or slow site into a modern one without losing the rankings you already have. Includes redirect mapping, rewritten content, and a mobile-first layout.

  • Landing page design

    A single focused page built for one goal, like booking a call or requesting a quote. Useful for ads, promotions, or a service you want more of.

  • Ecommerce website design

    Online stores for local businesses that sell products. Clear product pages, simple checkout, and setup for local pickup or shipping.

  • UX/UI design

    Layout and navigation tactically planned to keep your leads hooked on the page, so visitors find what they need and get in touch faster.

  • Website speed optimization

    Fix the heavy images, bloated code, and slow hosting that keep pages from loading. Faster pages hold visitors and support better rankings.

  • Website copywriting

    Website copy that explains what you do, who you help, and why someone should pick you. Written in your voice, for your customers.

  • Website migration

    Move your site to a new platform or host without breaking pages or losing search traffic. Includes redirect mapping and a check after the move.

  • Conversion rate optimization

    Changes that turn more of the visitors you already have into leads: clearer calls to action, better forms, trust signals, and tested layouts.

  • Service area page design

    A page for each town you serve, with real local detail, so customers in those areas and Google can both see that you work there.

  • Online booking setup

    Let customers book a call, a consult, or a job straight from your site. Connects to your calendar so you stop trading voicemails just to find a time that works.

Internet marketing service

Search engine optimization and AI search for Denton and DFW businesses. Built on clean pages, useful content, and credibility search engines can verify.

  • Search engine optimization

    Improve how your site ranks for the searches that bring paying customers. Built on clean pages, useful content, and real credibility.

  • SEO audit

    A plain-English review of what is holding your site back, with a prioritized fix list covering technical issues, content gaps, and local signals.

  • Technical SEO

    Fix what stops Google reading your site properly: indexing errors, broken links, duplicate pages, slow pages, and mobile problems.

  • On-page SEO

    Tune each page's titles, headings, content, and internal links so Google can tell what the page is about and which town it serves.

  • Link building

    Earn links from real local sites: chambers, sponsorships, partners, and local news. No link schemes that put your site at risk.

  • Citation building

    Get your name, address, and phone listed correctly on the directories that count, so Google and customers see the same details everywhere.

  • Local listings cleanup

    Track down the wrong and duplicate listings, old phone numbers and addresses, that confuse customers and undercut your local rankings.

  • Schema markup

    Structured data that tells search engines your business type, services, service area, and reviews in a format they read without guessing.

  • Blog writing

    Articles that answer the questions customers ask before they buy. Written for people first, and planned around what brings in work.

  • SEO content writing

    Service and location page content that is specific, accurate, and built to rank, using real detail from your business instead of filler.

  • Rank tracking and geo-grid reports

    See where you rank across your whole service area on Google Maps, not just at your own address, in monthly reports that show what moved.

  • Competitor analysis

    Find out why competitors outrank you in Maps and search, and get a plan to close the gap on their categories, content, and links.

  • Google Search Console setup

    Connect your site to Search Console so you can see what you show up for, fix indexing problems, and catch issues early.

  • Website analytics setup

    See where your visitors come from and which pages turn them into calls and form fills, reported in plain numbers you can act on instead of a dashboard you never open.

  • AI Overview optimization

    Get your pages picked up in Google's AI Overviews and cited by ChatGPT and other AI tools. Also called generative engine optimization (GEO) or answer engine optimization (AEO): same goal, different name.

  • AI citation building

    Earn the mentions and links AI tools actually pull from, so your business gets named when people ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Gemini for recommendations in your industry.

  • AI search visibility audit

    Find out whether your business shows up when people ask AI tools what you do, see who is beating you there, and get a fix-it plan ranked by what moves the needle fastest.

  • Answer-ready content writing

    Content written and formatted so AI assistants and search engines can pull it out and quote it directly: clear direct answers up front, real specifics, no fluff to wade through.

Marketing agency

Local marketing for Denton and DFW businesses: Google Business Profile, reviews, listings, local SEO, and getting recommended by AI search tools.

  • Google Business Profile setup

    Build your profile correctly from day one: the right categories, services, service area, hours, photos, and a description that follows Google's rules.

  • Google Business Profile optimization

    Fill out an existing profile properly, with the right categories, services, descriptions, photos, and attributes, so it shows up for more local searches.

  • Google Business Profile management

    Monthly care for your profile: posts, photos, service updates, questions and answers, review replies, and watching for unwanted edits.

  • Review generation strategy

    A simple system for asking happy customers for reviews at the right moment, with text and email templates that stay inside Google's review policies.

  • Review response management

    Replies to your reviews, good and bad, that show future customers how you handle people and keep the profile active.

  • Bing Places listing setup

    Claim and verify your listing on Bing Places so you show up in Bing search and maps, including on Windows devices and in the AI assistants that pull local results from Bing.

  • Apple Maps listing setup

    Set up and verify your business on Apple Business Connect so iPhone users find you in Apple Maps, Siri, and Spotlight, with the right hours, photos, and contact details.

Marketing consultant

One-on-one marketing and SEO consulting for owner-operated businesses in Denton and DFW. Straight answers and a plan you can act on yourself.

  • SEO consulting

    One-on-one advice from the person doing the work. Straight answers about your rankings, your site, and your Google profile, plus a plan you can act on.

  • Marketing strategy

    Help deciding where to put your marketing time and money, based on what brings in customers for owner-operated local businesses.

  • Website strategy session

    A working session to plan your pages, services, and site structure before you build or rebuild, so it serves customers and search engines both.

  • Google Business Profile training

    Learn to run your own profile: posting, replying to reviews, adding services and photos, and avoiding the changes that trigger suspensions.

  • SEO training for business owners

    Practical training for owners or staff who want to handle basic SEO in-house, from writing service pages to tracking what moved.

  • Photo and video strategy

    What to photograph and film for your profile and website so customers see real work and real people at the angle your business shines best.
